Cricket South Africa · MVNO · South Africa · 2026

The fan's network, run by Cricket South Africa.

Proteas Mobile is a mobile network under the CSA name. It keeps fans in the CSA app between fixtures, sells more tickets and tours, and gives CSA's partners fans who asked to hear from them. DSG runs the network. CSA owns the brand and the fans, and half of the profit.

Cricket South Africa today

A national team with a nation behind it.

CSA reaches more fans than almost any sporting body in the country. It launched its own app on 15 May 2026 and its own travel company, SA Cricket Travel with Tourvest, in December 2025. Both are built for match days. Proteas Mobile is built for every other day.23

4.1mFacebook followers, with 4.6 million video views1
1bn+viewers reached by CSA broadcasts across 100 territories1
119,926KFC Mini-Cricket players in 4,652 schools, in all 52 districts1
30%more women and girls playing over three years1
Newlands, Cape Town
What is at stake

85% of CSA's revenue is set by broadcasters and the ICC. Fans are the line CSA can grow itself.

In 2024/25 CSA earned R1.4bn. Broadcast rights brought R707m, ICC distributions R378m and ICC events R101m. Sponsors added about R140m.1 In 2025/26 CSA reported a loss of R440m.4 A sports app is busy on match days. The weeks between series are when fans drift.

The Integrated Report gives sponsorship as R140m on its business-model page and R125m in the CFO review. We use R140m. The Proteas Mobile bar is the DSG MVNE planning case on the numbers page.

The idea

One Proteas SIM that works for every part of CSA.

A network can sell data. Only CSA can sell being a Proteas fan. Every feature of Proteas Mobile sends the fan back to something CSA sells.

The CSA app

Free to use on every plan, with a Proteas Mobile tab for data, offers and the fan's club. Measured by monthly active users between series.

Tickets and the shop

Gold fans hear first when tickets go on sale. Measured by tickets and shop orders per line.

SA Cricket Travel

An On Tour eSIM inside every tour package. Measured by packages sold with On Tour.

Partners

Offers to fans who opted in, at the right moment. Measured by offers taken up, reported to each partner.

Grassroots

Every line names a club or school. CSA can direct part of its share there. Measured by clubs named and players registered.

A new income line

CSA keeps 50% of the net profit. Measured monthly, in rand.

The plans

Four plans, each built on something CSA already owns.

Every plan answers one question: which part of CSA does it grow? Gold and Family carry Bitdefender and a Personal Cyber Warranty from eInsurer, so fans buying tickets online are protected from scams. CSA sets the final names and prices.

What each plan earns, per line a month

Rand. Prices include VAT at 15%, removed first. Network and services covers the network, the CSA app data and the protection partners. Running costs (care, SIMs, offers and the MVNE fee) come out of gross profit before the 50/50 split; the full model below includes them.

PlanPrice incl VATVAT 15%Network and servicesGross profitGross marginCSA's 50%Share of lines
Proteas Fan14919.4362.09 67.4852%33.7473%
Proteas Gold29939.00121.87 138.1353%69.0617%
Proteas Family49965.09213.73 220.1851%110.099%

Plan prices are set by DSG MVNE for South Africa and include VAT at 15%. Bitdefender and the Personal Cyber Warranty are included at DSG's published prices and shared 50/50 with those partners. The mix of fans across plans is a DSG planning assumption for CSA to replace with its own app data.

What a fan gets

Fans get more for the same money, and things no other network can give them.

A network's 30-day 2.5GB data bundle costs R149, data only.9 Proteas Fan costs the same R149 and gives 3GB, 100 minutes, 50 SMS and the CSA app free on top. Proteas Gold includes R64.47 a month of phone protection (Bitdefender R52.47 and a R10,000 Personal Cyber Warranty at R12). Proteas Family includes R139.64 (Bitdefender Family for 5 devices R115.64 and a R25,000 warranty at R24).

Play

A fantasy league and predictions only a Proteas network can run.

Games give fans a reason to open the CSA app every day, not only on match days. The SIM is the fan's ID, so each line gets one team, with no fake accounts and fair prizes. Prizes can be things only CSA can give.

Proteas Fantasy League

Pick your Proteas XI before every Test, ODI and T20I. Points come from the real match, with a captain bonus.

Club, school and office leagues

Mini-leagues for every club, school and workplace. Your Mini-Cricket club against the next town's.

Predict every over

Next over, top scorer, the result. Right calls earn Proteas Caps.

Proteas Caps

Proteas Mobile's own reward points. Spend them on data, tickets, the shop or a day with the team.

Between series

Draft your all-time Proteas XI, weekly quizzes and Mini-Cricket challenges.

World Cup 2027 Predictor

Every match, one national table. Visitors on a Proteas eSIM can play too.

Sixes for Data

Every Proteas six drops data on every fan watching in the CSA app, to claim before the next over. A partner can own the six.

Free to play, no money staked, so it is not betting. Sixes for Data is funded by a partner or by CSA, with the data per six and a cap per match set by CSA. Run as a promotional competition, with a legal check before launch. Scoring needs a live match data feed in the CSA app. Partner-sponsored rounds give CSA something new to sell to its sponsors. Game names, prizes and Caps are for CSA to decide.

Partners

Partners reach fans who said yes.

Today a sponsor buys a logo on the boundary and hopes fans notice. With Proteas Mobile, fans opt in through the CSA app, in line with POPIA. BroadBrand's Xanite sends the right offer at the right moment, in CSA's name, and partners see what worked. That gives CSA something new to sell at its next sponsorship renewal.

1. Fan opts in

A clear choice in the CSA app. Fans can change it at any time.

2. The right moment

Match days, ticket sales and tours, when attention is highest.

3. Results reported

Each partner sees offers sent and taken up. CSA keeps the fan relationship.

ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2027

The world comes to South Africa. Proteas Mobile can be ready first.

The tournament runs from 2 October to 21 November 2027: 14 teams, 57 matches and 12 venues, eight of them in South Africa. The final is at the Wanderers.6 Proteas Mobile can be live well before then, so local fans join early and visiting fans land on a Proteas eSIM. Visitor eSIM pricing is to be confirmed.

Proof

DStv Internet runs its network on our platform.

DStv Internet carries 9% of MTN's data traffic on the MVNE platform. DSG's own network, Digital Mobile, runs on the same platform, and MVNE has worked in the sector since 2013. Proteas Mobile would run on the same platform, with the same team.7

The numbers

Worth R349.5m to CSA over five years.

A planning case: about 1 in 10 of CSA's 4.1 million Facebook followers takes a Proteas line by year 5, or 410,000 lines. Move the levers to test it. CSA's own app data should replace this sizing in the CVP workshop.

R349.5mCSA's share over five years
R551.9mvalue of CSA's share, discounted at 15% with a five-times exit
R768.3mnetwork revenue in year 5, before VAT
R97,000weakest month's net profit (no month runs at a loss)

CSA's share by year

Year 1Year 2Year 3Year 4Year 5

DSG MVNE model, 60 months, rand, before VAT. Lines ramp to 10%, 30%, 55%, 80% and 100% of the year-5 target, starting with 2,000 lines at launch. Revenue assumes 88% of plan value is realised. Running costs include care, SIMs and RICA, Xanite offers and the MVNE fee of R7.50 a line or R75,000 a month. Net profit is shared 50/50 after the R250,000 build fee, which CSA pays upfront.

Who owns what

CSA owns the brand and the fans. The profit is split 50/50.

R250,000Build fee, once

Paid upfront at signature. It covers the Proteas Mobile build on the MVNE platform.

R7.50MVNE platform fee

A line a month, or R75,000 a month, whichever is higher.

50/50Net profit share

After network, partner and running costs, CSA and DSG share the profit equally.

CSA decides

CSA sets every plan, price and offer. The brand is CSA's.

Fan data stays CSA's

Held for CSA under POPIA, used only with the fan's consent.

From signature to live in South Africa, where MVNE is already integrated with MTN.

KFC Mini-Cricket: 119,926 players in 4,652 schools across all 52 districts. Female participation up 30% over three years.

  4. TimesLIVE, "CSA makes R440m loss in last financial year", 26 September 2026.
  5. Cricket South Africa, fixtures release, 2 November 2026: Proteas men v Bangladesh, Wanderers 15 to 19 November 2026.
  6. ICC, "ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2027 schedule revealed", October 2026, icc-cricket.com. 2 October to 21 November 2027, 14 teams, 57 matches, 12 venues (eight in South Africa), final at the Wanderers.

  8. DSG MVNE model for Proteas Mobile, November 2026. Plan prices, the plan mix, the ramp and the year-5 target of 410,000 lines (about 10% of reference 1's Facebook followers) are planning assumptions for CSA to replace with its own data.
  9. ICASA, Bi-annual report on the analysis of tariff notifications, 1 July to 31 December 2025, published 23 March 2026. 30-day bundles of 2GB to 3GB at R149 (Cell C, MTN 2.5GB, Telkom 2.5GB) to R165 (Vodacom 3GB).
